title: Fix the Exception That Hides the Real Bug
description: The program should parse a list of number strings and clearly report any that fail to parse.
expectedBehavior: The program should report which value failed to parse, rather than silently ignoring it.
actualProblem: Catching the broad Exception type and doing nothing but adding 0 silently swallows the NumberFormatException from parsing 'abc', giving no indication that any input was invalid — the bug in the data goes completely unnoticed.
explanation: Catching the specific exception you expect (NumberFormatException here) and logging or reporting it keeps failures visible, instead of catching the overly broad Exception and silently discarding the information about what went wrong.
